_description: Pillar 8 — Plans-tree governance (per-pillar rule model). Carries the plans-pillar _rules[] SoT (home=plans; R-29/R-30/R-31 librarian-tier, R-56 skill-tier, R-61/R-62 master/sub reconciler-tier, R-63 advisory-tier), the canonical 6-state plan lifecycle, the subplan_rules.metadata_flow orchestrator-worker contract, the per-plan ADR ledger convention, and the structural config the plans-tree is validated against. Loaded by hooks/pre-write-guard.sh + the librarian plan/backlog capabilities.

_design_notes.consumer: hooks/pre-write-guard.sh (R-27/R-28 via naming pillar; librarian-only root-file writes), skills/librarian/capabilities/{plan-index,backlog-index}.sh, the librarian reconciler (R-61/R-62/R-63 cross-file)
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: R-37 documentary lockstep — there is NO write-time DENY for R-37; enforcement = git commit-boundary atomicity + librarian governance-parity-audit at session-close. This pillar + its schema + contracts + hook move in one commit.

_rules.rule_text: Backlog row size is bounded — a row in the unified _backlog.md carries only a current-state pointer; session history lives in the satellite, not the row. Held by construction by the librarian backlog-index capability for every generated column; the Notes column is carried forward unchanged and is the one unbounded column.
_rules.failure_mode: Unbounded backlog rows accrete session narrative inline; the index becomes a log; scan-readability collapses. Held by construction (backlog-index), never write-time and not a skill check.

_rules.rule_text: Backlog sentinel pattern — the row carries the current-state pointer; the satellite at the plan dir / handoff.md is the single source of session history. Held by construction: the librarian backlog-index capability renders the sentinel-bounded regions from the plan manifests.
_rules.failure_mode: Drift between row and satellite; history scattered. Held by construction (backlog-index), never write-time and not a skill check.

_rules.rule_text: Backlog sentinel pattern (companion to R-30) — sentinel-bounded row regions are librarian-regenerated; operator narrative is preserved outside the sentinels. Held by construction: the librarian backlog-index capability renders the sentinel-bounded regions from the plan manifests.
_rules.failure_mode: Hand-edits inside sentinel regions are clobbered on regen, or stale regions diverge. Held by construction (backlog-index), never write-time and not a skill check.

_rules.rule_text: Every backlog row (idea note or {researching,planned} manifest) carries a disposition signal (FIX NOW / ABSORB / STANDALONE / NO-BUILD). backlog-hygiene escalates severity Warning -> Alert by stale_for_days against backlog_row.stale_advisory_days when a disposition is missing.
_rules.failure_mode: Undisposed backlog rows float indefinitely; the GTD review loop has nothing to act on. Skill-enforced (backlog-hygiene), never write-time.

_rules.rule_text: Master sub_plans[] aggregation-integrity: the master manifest's sub_plans[].status read-replica MUST agree with each sub-plan's real published status. Cross-file invariant enforced by the librarian reconciler (NOT write-time) — extends trinity-drift-detect.sh / drift-sweep.sh with the master<->sub aggregation axis; detects (and optionally --fix) drift.
_rules.failure_mode: A master's sub_plans[] read-replica goes stale against the subs' real status; the master shows a sub as in-progress that has actually completed (or vice-versa); orchestration decisions read a phantom aggregate. Cross-file -> reconciler at session-close, never a blocking write-time path.

_rules.rule_text: Sub-publishes-upward: a sub-plan publishes its status + graduation_timestamp upward to the master (the master reads them into sub_plans[]); a sub MUST NOT mutate the master aggregate directly. Cross-file invariant enforced by the librarian reconciler (NOT write-time).
_rules.failure_mode: A sub-plan fails to publish a status transition, or attempts to write the master aggregate directly, breaking the pull-based read-replica model. Cross-file -> reconciler at session-close.

_rules.rule_text: Sub-peer-isolation: a sub-plan manifest MUST NOT carry a dependencies edge to a sibling sub-plan — route through the master manifest (the orchestrator-worker invariant: workers report only to the orchestrator, never to each other). Surfaced as a librarian reconciler drift finding (advisory).
_rules.failure_mode: A sub declares a direct dependency on a sibling sub, recreating the agent-teams peer model the orchestrator-worker model deliberately rejects (MAST coordination-failure class). Advisory drift finding at session-close.

enforcement_layer: pre-write-guard.sh plan-artifact frontmatter gate (write-time DENY on the 5 canonical basenames; marker R65_PROMOTED)
schemas/plans-schema.json (the filename-to-type map + per-type required[] cohort the gate reads)
_rules.failure_mode: A canonical plan artifact (spec.md / tasks.md / handoff.md / 00-ideation-brief.md) written with a missing or non-canonical type: field is invisible or mis-routed to every type-keyed consumer (renderers, validators, index walkers). Promoted from advisory to write-time DENY once the corpus floor measured clean (3 named historical stragglers corpus-wide at promotion).
_rules.rule_text: The 5 canonical Markdown plan artifacts must carry the canonical type: for their basename (spec.md -> spec, tasks.md -> tasks, handoff.md -> handoff, 00-ideation-brief.md -> ideation-brief, traceability-matrix.md -> traceability-matrix) per schemas/plans-schema.json. Missing or mismatched type: DENIES the write; the deny message carries the canonical frontmatter stub (DERIVE: no status: in artifact frontmatter). Escape hatch for field over-fire: R65_ALLOW_OVERRIDE=1 downgrades the gate to the legacy advisory for that write. All other arms of the plan-frontmatter block (status-line enum, library/binder reach) remain advisory.
_rules.legacy_label_note: RENAME COMPLETED: the guard block's emitted advisory strings historically carried '[R-40 PLAN FRONTMATTER]' (and sibling [R-40 LIBRARY/BINDER]) prefixes — a label collision, since the bare R-40 id is owned by the frontmatter pillar's provides-canonicality rule. The prefixes are now the neutral mechanism labels [PLAN FRONTMATTER] / [LIBRARY INDEX] / [LIBRARY ARTICLE] / [BINDER]; every pinned fixture and the sentinel corpus moved in the same lockstep commit, so R-40 resolves uniquely to the frontmatter pillar rule. This entry (R-65) is the registered id of the promoted type gate; deny messages name the mechanism and R-65, never an advisory label.
_rules.rollback: R65_ALLOW_OVERRIDE=1 (env, per-write) downgrades to the legacy advisory; a durable rollback is a substance change to this entry's tier + the guard emission branch, one commit, master rebuild + manifest regen coupled.

root_namespace._description: CLOSED plans-root namespace. The plans-tree root admits ONLY the entry classes enumerated in allowed_entry_classes — nothing else. This is the single source of truth read by the write-time root-allowlist guard (hooks/pre-write-guard.sh, positioned before R-27), the sweep-side rule (skills/librarian/capabilities/placement-validate.sh), and the shared classifier hooks/lib/plan-path.sh::classify_root_entry. A root entry matching no allowed class is non-conforming: ask->deny at write-time (advisory-to-blocking rollout), flagged by the sweep. Rationale: session outputs with no owning plan otherwise invent root surfaces whose records get no lifecycle; a closed namespace routes durable artifacts to their owning context instead.

plan_dirs._description: NN-<slug> plan directories (conforming-active; R-27-governed prefix + status).

legacy_flat_plans._description: Depth-1 flat NN-<slug>.md plans — kept in place, not retroactively invalidated (each carries inbound citations). CLOSED class: the scaffolder mints directories only, so no new flat-plan members can appear through the sanctioned path.

root_files._description: Librarian-generated root registry files (also enumerated under root_files above).

funnel_registry_surfaces._description: Enumerated funnel + registry directories: _inbox (pre-plan idea capture), _projects (per-spoke binder registry), _library (universal-only cross-project library). Historical registry documents are deliberately NOT enumerated surfaces — the governance JSON pillar is the live rule source of truth, and a historical map file is not a durable root registry.

dot_entries._description: Leading-dot entries (.git, .gitignore, .DS_Store, .active-plan, dotfiles) are class-exempt so the closed namespace does not fight VCS/OS/pointer machinery.

root_namespace._grandfathered_note: TRANSITIONAL-ONLY; ad-hoc dirs are never grandfathered — non-conforming stock is re-homed to its owning context, not blessed as a durable root surface. An entry names a still-present historical root file pending relocation out of the plans root: the write guard must never deny writes to a file that still lives at the root. The re-homing pass that relocates a file removes its entry in the same change. Currently EMPTY — every historical root file has been relocated to its owning context; an empty list is the completed state, and the mechanism stays for any future transitional need.
root_namespace._rollout_note: Advisory-to-blocking (ask->deny) rollout idiom — FLIPPED to deny at the re-home completion (the non-conforming ad-hoc root stock now lives in its owning plan; the ask phase ran clean). PLANS_ROOT_ROLLOUT=ask restores the advisory path; PLANS_ROOT_OK=1 is the per-write, audit-logged escape hatch.

metadata_flow._description: Orchestrator-worker contract for first-class master/sub-plan structure. Maps onto Claude Code's subagent orchestrator-worker invariant: workers run in isolated contexts, report only to the orchestrator, and NEVER communicate with each other — the deliberate OPPOSITE of the agent-teams peer model. Master/sub aggregation is pull-based and DERIVED: the master sub_plans[] is a librarian-generated read-replica (same trust class as _index.md), NEVER hand-edited.
metadata_flow.aggregation_model: pull-based-derived-read-replica (librarian reconciler reads each sub's published status into the master's sub_plans[]; never hand-edited; same class as _index.md)

required_artifacts._description: Per-transition required artifacts a status flip MUST present. Consumed by the librarian reconciler.

parent_plan_exempt_files: Plan-root files at depth 2 (spec.md, tasks.md, handoff.md, 00-ideation-brief.md, README.md, manifest.json) — they ARE the parent
handoff.md at any depth (append-only session record)

decision_records._description: Per-plan ADR (Architecture Decision Record) ledger. Short, immutable, individually-addressable, supersession-tracked decision records. Optional: a plan with no recorded decisions has no decisions/ dir. Body-structure contract at governance/file-type-contracts/adr.md.json; manifest pointer array at schemas/plan-manifest-schema.json :: decision_records[].
decision_records.placement_rule: repo-tier (docs/decisions/, 4-digit) IFF the decision changes adopter-inherited foundation behavior; else plan-tier (<plan>/decisions/ADR-NN-<slug>.md, 2-digit).
decision_records.agent_reload_contract: On plan resume, load non-superseded ADRs via manifest.decision_records[] as the decision context — NOT spec-prose archaeology.
decision_records.tooling: NONE (no adr-tools / log4brains). Markdown-in-git + librarian enumeration covers it; bundling violates minimum-viable.
decision_records.immutability: An accepted ADR is immutable. A decision change creates a NEW ADR that supersedes the prior one (prior Status -> superseded-by-ADR-NN); never an in-place edit. Distinct from the spec.md append-amendment pattern.

gate_records._rationale: Gate records (validation charges, round records, verdicts) live in one flat <plan>/_gates/ folder, so validation exhaust never enters a plan's declared research. Both ends of the research inflow guard read this key: hooks/pre-write-guard.sh refuses a new gate-named or prefix-colliding file under _research/, and plan-research-declare refuses to declare either. Gate-named: a basename token, split on -, _ or ., equals a keyword or fully matches a keyword pattern.

backlog_row._required_fields_note: Project Dir carries the row's owning Claude project-home directory, resolved from the manifest/note `project:` spoke key via governance/anchored-spoke-registry.json cwd_anchors (the same per-row ownership standard the plan index uses); Target carries the machine-joinable promoted_to/absorbed_into plan-dir key.

settled_section._note: Derived settled ledger rendered below the active table by librarian:backlog-index — THREE sources: graduated items joined from plan manifests' promoted_from, absorption joins from plan manifests' absorbed_notes[] (one row per listed note, landing plan named; a note-side row for the same note takes precedence), and inbox notes carrying a terminal resolution (flat or in the settled home); never hand-kept.

backlog_row._stale_advisory_days_note: [advisory_threshold, escalation_threshold] in days for a backlog row missing a disposition. backlog-index emits backlog-row-missing-disposition once per run; backlog-hygiene escalates severity Warning->Alert by stale_for_days against these thresholds (R-56).

inbox._description: Pre-plan idea capture surface. Lightweight per-idea notes at ~/.claude-plans/_inbox/<slug>.md — cheap capture, extended-form body that grows in place, hook-unblocked (hooks/lib/plan-path.sh::classify_plan_path returns is_plan=0 so R-27 prefix/status never fires). Rendered into the unified _backlog.md by librarian:backlog-index. Graduates to a full plan via the idea->plan promote path (migrates body -> 00-ideation-brief.md, scaffolds the NN- quartet, tombstones the note).
inbox._settled_dir_note: Settled home for funnel notes, FORWARD-ONLY: a settlement EVENT (the librarian:backlog-index closure-loop stamp, or the librarian:inbox-settle manual channel) relocates the note here in the same run; already-settled notes sitting flat are never moved by the renderer. The one carve-out is a parked NO-BUILD note: when its registered reopen_gate is met, backlog-index moves it back to the flat inbox with the disposition and resolution cleared (reopen_gates, resolution parked). The settled ledger renders residents of this folder at their real location; a resident without settlement evidence draws the inbox-settled-misfiled advisory. A settled note keeps owning its slug — capture collision-versioning probes this folder too.
inbox._slug_pattern_note: Inbox notes have NO NN- numeric prefix (distinct from plan slugs). The prefix is assigned at graduation, not at capture — avoids prefix burn on discarded ideas.

note_frontmatter._project_note: Registry-resolved owning-spoke key (governance/anchored-spoke-registry.json), stamped mechanically at capture by the promote-from-inbox helper; graduation precedence is the --project flag, then the note key, then cwd auto-resolution.
note_frontmatter._class_keys_note: A STANDALONE disposition is decided at capture with a release_class from release_class_enum and a size from size_enum; the promote-from-inbox helper refuses either value outside its enum and stamps both keys. They apply to STANDALONE only.
note_frontmatter._reopen_keys_note: A NO-BUILD disposition carries reopen_gate: the id of a gate in inbox.reopen_gates. A note's frontmatter only ever names an id; the gate itself is registered here. backlog-index stamps reopened_at and reopened_from_gate when it re-opens a parked note.
note_frontmatter._target_keys_note: promoted_to/absorbed_into are machine-joinable plan-dir keys — NN-<slug> or a sub-plan NN-<slug>/SS-<subslug>, with an optional ' :: T-N' task suffix — resolvable against the plans root; an ABSORB disposition requires a resolvable absorbed_into at triage.

inbox._resolution_note: Terminal settlement vocabulary, orthogonal to funnel_status_enum: stamped write-if-changed by the librarian:backlog-index closure loop when a note's target plan reaches lifecycle.terminal_status — settled notes render in the settled ledger and leave the active table. 'superseded' records replaced-by-other-work (pair with superseded_by); 'discharged' records need-eliminated-at-source by a named fix. Classification precedence: terminal-resolution EVIDENCE wins over funnel status — a note also settles on an out-of-enum resolution when corroborated by resolved_at or superseded_by (operator-judgment settlement an enum cannot enumerate), and that path emits the inbox-resolution-out-of-enum advisory so vocabulary drift stays visible instead of mis-rendering the note. 'parked' records a NO-BUILD decision settled under a re-open gate: unlike 'dropped' it is re-openable (see reopen_gates).
inbox._reopen_gates_note: Closed registry of re-open gates a NO-BUILD note may name through its reopen_gate key, an object keyed by gate id so an overlay can ADD an id. A gate is {"kind": "manual"} (an operator re-opens the note with skills/backlog-triage/scripts/reopen-idea.sh <slug>; backlog-index never evaluates it) or {"kind": "command", "argv": [<path>, <args>...], "timeout_s": <n>}. argv[0] is an absolute path or a path relative to the foundation root (no leading slash, no .. component); the command runs without a shell, and exit 0 means the gate is met. hooks/lib/reopen-gate.sh is the reader.
inbox._undecided_threshold_note: The count of open undecided flat inbox notes (a note is decided only as STANDALONE with a release_class and a size, ABSORB with a resolvable absorbed_into, or NO-BUILD with a registered reopen_gate) above which the SessionStart reader surfaces an inbox-drain line. The librarian:inbox-drain-check capability persists the count and this value; a session close blocks only on that session's own undecided captures, never on this total.
inbox._capture_freeze_record_note: Path pattern (plans-root-relative, <spoke> standing for the spoke key) of a spoke's capture-freeze record: one line start_sha=<40-hex>, the plans-repo commit that recorded the opening ruling. While the file exists, backlog-index reports every open flat note of that spoke added to _inbox/ after that commit that carries no target (an ABSORB into a plan or sub-plan key that resolves to a manifest.json, or a STANDALONE disposition with release_class post-release, the next patch release); an absent file means no freeze is in force. hooks/lib/field-set.sh capture-freeze open|lift <spoke> writes and removes the record.
inbox._near_duplicate_note: Thresholds the near-duplicate scorer (hooks/lib/inbox-near-dup.sh) applies to a pair of idea notes. overlap_min is the Jaccard overlap of title plus Idea-section tokens (template placeholder lines excluded) at which a pair is flagged on its own; corroborated_overlap_min applies when the pair also shares a path:line cite or a slug stem of stem_min_tokens (at least 2) leading hyphen tokens. A shared cite or stem alone never flags, and the overlap signal counts only when the pair shares at least min_shared_tokens tokens (a floor against two short titles that share one word). A note carrying a resolution is not open and is never scored as one. Calibrated over the real inbox so that both notes of each known duplicate pair flag. An overlay re-tunes a value by a plain deep-merge. A capture that matches an open note refuses unless --amend <existing> or --distinct-from <existing> with --distinct-scope names the difference.
inbox._index_file_note: Machine-written inbox index (active roster + settled roster + remediation highlights) rendered by librarian:backlog-index in the same pass as _backlog.md; excluded from the note walk.
inbox.body: free-form extended idea content (description / rationale / notes); grows in place across funnel stages until graduation

_status_model_note: Two object types, two vocabularies. (1) Plan manifests carry the ONE canonical 6-state `status` (lifecycle.status_enum below; on plan-manifest-schema.json :: status). (2) Inbox idea notes carry inbox.funnel_status_enum {new, triaged, briefed} — a DIFFERENT object type (a pre-plan idea note, not a plan manifest), NOT collapsed into the 6-state plan status. The inbox funnel is separate from the plan-status enum. backlog_row.status_enum is the documented union shown in the rendered _backlog.md view.

lifecycle._description: ONE canonical 6-state plan `status`. The single authoritative `status` lives on schemas/plan-manifest-schema.json :: status; this block declares the transition gates the librarian reconciler enforces. completed is the sole terminal done-state; superseded is also terminal and is set by a hand edit of the manifest status (the status setter refuses it), so no transition edge leads into it; archival is a display-only view filter over completed plans, never a status.

in-progress->completed._note: completed = the human's claim that work is done; the sole terminal done-state
